output.answer: IBM's latest reported annual revenue is $67.535 billion for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. This is the most recent completed full-year figure available as of November 11, 2026.
caveats: This is the latest completed fiscal-year revenue; IBM's 2026 annual revenue was not yet a completed fiscal-year figure as of November 11, 2026.

passages.quote: Full-Year Highlights - Revenue of $67.5 billion, up 8 percent

output.question: What is IBM's annual revenue?

key_facts.fact: IBM total revenue was $67,535 million ($67.535 billion) for the year ended December 31, 2025.
IBM reported 2025 full-year revenue growth of 8 percent year over year in its January 28, 2026 results release.
